## Projects

  Source: https://github.com/OgabekHub/devcommons

  manufacturer. React, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion.
- [Zetra Store](https://zetra-store-one.vercel.app/): e-commerce storefront with

  Source: https://github.com/OgabekHub/zetra-store
- [NexusDevs](https://nexusdevs-xi.vercel.app/): landing page for a development
  agency. Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS.
  Source: https://github.com/OgabekHub/nexusdevs
